transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer accounts and billing. My name is Julian. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Julian. I am calling about a catastrophic billing error on my account. On Friday I logged into the website and paid my monthly broadband bill of thirty-eight pounds fifty by debit card because I wanted to clear it early. But then this morning, S-Net took another thirty-eight pounds fifty by Direct Debit!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly investigate that duplicate payment deduction for you. Before we inspect the ledger entries, may I please verify the full billing address and your security question answer?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 14 Meadowbank Gardens, Cheltenham, GL51 9PW. And the security question answer is my first primary school, St Michael's.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that verifies the billing account records. What is the account reference number?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The account reference is ACC-440192. Julian, I am a single mother working part-time and I live on a razor-thin monthly budget! Because S-Net took that second payment unexpectedly, my bank account was plunged forty pounds into an unarranged overdraft, and my bank has slapped me with a forty-five pound penalty charge! My card got declined at the pharmacy this morning when trying to buy infant medicine and milk for my two-year-old daughter! I was reduced to tears of humiliation at the counter! I desperately need that money refunded back today!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Automated Direct Debit processing cycles lock payment files three banking days prior to collection dates.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why does the payment portal let customers pay manually if your computer still pulls the Direct Debit anyway?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am opening the payment ledger journal for invoice number INV-882190 to examine the transaction batch stamps.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What do the payment batch records show?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The transaction journal shows a card payment authorization of thirty-eight pounds fifty on Friday at two fifteen PM via Worldpay gateway.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And then the Direct Debit cleared today on Monday morning, right?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The BACS Direct Debit instruction was transmitted to your issuing bank on Thursday evening as part of the automated monthly clearing run.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So paying online on Friday didn't stop the Monday Direct Debit from going through?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: BACS clearing files cannot be recalled once dispatched to the central automated clearing house within forty-eight banking hours of settlement.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can S-Net refund that duplicate thirty-eight pounds fifty immediately back onto my debit card?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Under our billing operational procedures, duplicate payments produce a credit balance on the account ledger that rolls over against the next invoice.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I cannot wait thirty days for next month's bill! I have literally zero pounds in my current account and my bank is penalizing me forty-five pounds for being overdrawn! I need the cash in my bank account right now!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If your bank charges you overdraft fees because thirty-eight pounds was debited, that is a personal budgeting issue between you and your bank, not an S-Net problem.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How dare you speak to me like that! You took money that you were not entitled to take! That is not poor budgeting, that is unauthorized deduction by your company! I demand that you reverse it and refund me this instant!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can submit an expedited Faster Payments refund request directly through our finance operations portal.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How quickly does a Faster Payments refund reach my bank account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Faster Payments bank transfers process within two hours of supervisor authorization.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will the supervisor authorize the refund today?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have flagged the electronic transfer ticket as priority category A for finance supervisor sign-off.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What about the forty-five pound overdraft fee my bank charged me because of your duplicate deduction?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you upload a digital copy of your bank statement showing the bank penalty charge to our secure portal, our billing department can assess a goodwill credit reimbursement.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have my banking app open on my phone right now. Where do I upload the PDF statement?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Log into your S-Net online portal, select Billing & Payments, click 'Dispute Charge', and attach the PDF statement file under ticket REF-99014.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have uploaded the bank statement showing the forty-five pound unpaid item fee. Did that come through on your system?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The document attachment has successfully ingested into ticket REF-99014.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you also credit my S-Net account for that forty-five pounds so I don't have to worry about next month's bill?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have applied a forty-five pound goodwill credit balance to your S-Net broadband account to offset the bank penalty.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, that helps enormously. When will my next payment be due?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Because the credit balance covers your next monthly charge of thirty-eight pounds fifty, your invoice balance for next month will be zero pounds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So I won't have any broadband bill to pay in November?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct, zero pounds will be debited on your November payment date.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How can I avoid duplicate deductions happening in the future if I ever want to pay early?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you maintain an active Direct Debit mandate, do not submit manual card payments within five working days of the scheduled payment date.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It would be very helpful if your website warned customers about that five-day window before taking manual card payments.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have logged a digital feedback enhancement ticket with our web engineering team regarding an automated checkout warning prompt.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will definitely protect other people from getting caught out.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also verify your bank account details on file to confirm the Faster Payments refund routing.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The sort code is 40-22-19 and the account number ends in 8841.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The sort code 40-22-19 matches HSBC UK Bank PLC and aligns with the originating Direct Debit mandate.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is my primary current account.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously that confirms the electronic disbursement will clear directly into your spendable ledger balance today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That gives me peace of mind that I can buy food and medicine this afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: To download your official VAT credit note for your records, log into the customer billing portal, navigate to Invoices, and click 'Download Tax Credit Note PDF'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Clicking Invoices... I see Credit Note CR-10822 for forty-five pounds. I can save that to my phone files right away.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That PDF serves as official proof of balance adjustment under HMRC tax accounting guidelines.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is very helpful for my financial records.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check the Direct Debit payment limit protection to make sure your bank rejects any collections above forty pounds in future.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Where in the portal do we configure that payment ceiling?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Under Payment Settings, toggle 'Direct Debit Monthly Cap' and enter forty pounds as the maximum allowable collection amount.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have toggled the monthly cap and entered forty pounds. That prevents any accidental large debits.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check your broadband service and router status while we have your account profile open.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Our home broadband has been working fine; all the lights on the Hub are steady blue.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Line telemetry confirms steady sync at sixty-eight megabits per second download and eighteen megabits upload.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The internet connection has never given us any trouble.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us check your marketing preferences to ensure you do not receive unwanted promotional emails.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I prefer only essential account notifications and zero marketing.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have updated your privacy profile to opt out of third-party promotional marketing while keeping operational SMS alerts active.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is exactly how I want it configured.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to reconfirm, the refund amount scheduled for immediate release is thirty-eight pounds fifty, with forty-five pounds goodwill credit on the account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, thirty-eight pounds fifty cash refund and forty-five pounds credit. That is completely correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will remain the dedicated owner for this billing dispute and track the Faster Payments release until confirmation is logged.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you for getting the refund pushed through and sorting the credit.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You will receive an automated SMS payment receipt once the banking gateway clears the transfer.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will watch out for that text message.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else regarding your billing account or broadband service that I can assist you with today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that has resolved everything. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You may receive a short customer satisfaction survey by SMS after this call; we would appreciate any feedback on our service today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will complete the survey. Have a good afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Have a good day and take care.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, goodbye.
